text:
maria: Anyone else seeing remote_write p95 spike to ~3s on prom-receiver in eu-west-1? Started ~10:15 UTC, looks correlated with a burst in label-cardinality from gpu_exporter. SLO alerts are noisy and ingestion is getting throttled :eyes:
aditya: Yep, I can see it on Grafana. p50 ~200ms but p95 jumps. Panel: https://grafana.internal/d/ABC/prom-remote-write?orgId=1&from=1894506000&to=1894512000
lee: Logs from receiver show repeated `write request timeout` and `exceeded queue capacity` errors. snippet from prom-receiver logs:
```
2026-03-12T10:17:02Z level=error component=remote_write msg="writeSamples failed" err="timeout sending batch: context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-12T10:17:03Z level=warn component=remote_write msg="queue overflow" queued=0 capacity=5000
```
maria: I noticed gpu-exporter 0.8.2 rolled in last night and it started attaching `cuda_uuid` and `gpu_index` per metric. That will explode series count for gpu-heavy clusters (eu-west has a lot of bursty infra jobs).
aditya: Short-term mitigation: drop the per-device labels in Prometheus scrape config using metric_relabel_configs. Example to drop `cuda_uuid` and `gpu_index`:
```
metric_relabel_configs:
- action: labeldrop
  regex: "cuda_uuid|gpu_index"
```
This should collapse the cardinality back down without changing metrics semantics for our alerts.
ops-oncall: I can push a canary change to the eu-west scrape config in 15m and also bump prom-receiver queue_config to be a bit more forgiving (max_samples_per_send -> 100, batch_send_deadline -> 3s) while we verify. Will also create a temporary rule to suppress noisy SLO alerts.
aditya: Also suggest we enable a metric_relabel on the exporter side in the long term or patch the exporter to make per-device labels opt-in. For receiver-side hardening we can tune `max_shards` and add a per-tenant rate_limit on Cortex to avoid single-tenant floods.
maria: Can we scale the prom-receiver ASG by +2 instances as a buffer while the relabel goes out? CPU is hitting 85% on the two eu-west boxes.
lee: Scaling started: +2 instances, ASG autoscaling group prom-receiver-eu-west, expected healthy in ~6m. pinged @cloud-team for faster boot if needed :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary config applied to prometheus-eu (prometheus-eu-1) by ops-oncall at 1894509999
maria: After the canary, p95 dropped from ~3s -> ~800ms and queue backlog is decreasing. Still above baseline but much better. I'll open a PR to add exporter feature flag and an SLO to detect label explosions upstream.
aditya: Please also add an alert: `PrometheusHighCardinalityIncrease` that fires on >2x series growth over 5m for a job. That would've caught this earlier.
maria: Created follow-up ticket REDWOOD-4532 and assigned to eng-ml (exporter owners). Will keep monitoring and revert the canary if we see regressions. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
